integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite computations in the bundled verifier are diagnostic and are not used as a substitute for the polynomial and affine-geometric arguments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is global only within the ellipsoid class, for dimensions \(n\ge3\); it gives neither a stability modulus nor finite-direction reconstruction. The inaccessible full text of the 2001 Barker–Larman article leaves a residual historical-overlap risk, although later full-text sources summarize its pertinent partial results without an ellipsoid injectivity theorem.
title: Global Barker–Larman rigidity for ellipsoids
